tier_reason: The README names libopcodes, Capstone and Zydis only in an unquantified claim ('significantly faster ... due to the absence of high-level abstractions and the small lookup table'), with no numbers, harness, compiler, flags or CPU. decode-profile.c (added 2026-06-01) times only Fadec's own decode/format MB/s on a user-supplied file, with no baseline, and Fadec is absent from both athre0z/disas-bench and iximeow/disas-bench candidate lists; two WebSearch queries found no independent numbers.

corrections.stars_or_usage: 235 stars, 33 forks, 432 commits (github.com page, 2026-10-11). Used as a git submodule (deps/fadec) by the TPDE compiler back-end framework (tpde2/tpde .gitmodules, opened). Search results also show copies at android.googlesource.com platform/external/lfi/fadec (tagged android-17.0.0_r1) and a Chromium mirror chromium.googlesource.com/external/github.com/aengelke/fadec, plus forks oleavr/fadec and GenKyoko/fadec (snippet only; googlesource host did not resolve here).
corrections.caveats: No benchmark numbers or comparison harness anywhere: the speed claim over libopcodes, Capstone and Zydis is qualitative, and the only timing tool in the repo (decode-profile.c, added 2026-06-01) measures Fadec alone. Fadec is absent from the public disas-bench candidate lists (athre0z and iximeow forks). The encoder v2 '3x faster than v1' figure is an internal comparison with no baseline and comes at ~3 MiB code size (off by default, -Dwith_encode2=true). README lists known issues: low test coverage, register-uniqueness constraints not enforced (VSIB, AMX, AVX-512 FP16 complex multiply), decoded operand sizes not always exact, AMD64-specific behaviour not handled (Intel 64 semantics only), MPX, HLE, XOP, FMA4 and Xeon Phi unsupported. Baselines are disassembler libraries, not GNU as, NASM or MASM. Notability rests on reuse (TPDE, Android LFI, Chromium mirror) rather than stars. Canonical CI pulls from git.sr.ht/~aengelke/fadec.

notes: Record is accurate: BSD-3-Clause (LICENSE opened), not a fork, not archived, last commit 2026-06-01 (active), README claim and v2 '3x' quoted correctly. Keep at tier D with the shortcoming 'no numbers, qualitative speed claim only'; under 1k stars but reused by TPDE and shipped in Android's external/lfi tree, so not rejected.
